purpose: Compare paired held-person errors and fixed equal blending of PLS32 and GPU last_stage
selection: No weight search, calibration, clipping or person-specific model selection
reference_selection_limit: PLS dimension was selected inside training people; PLS candidate expansion and choice of GPU last_stage followed prior development results. This is exploratory reuse of development OOF predictions, not independent final validation.
aggregation: Absolute errors and bin indicators averaged within person across records and sides, then equally over people. Bias uses prediction minus truth. Population SD uses person-mean scores.
bands: floor(actual GDI / 10); within-band record-sides first averaged per person; a person may occur in more than one band

bootstrap.interpretation: paired conditional exploratory interval; does not include model selection or training uncertainty
